messages:
alex: Heads up — I need to merge a terraform change that grows the GPU pool in us-west-2 for an internal batch job. We're in a freeze window tho, asking about the exception flow :eyes:
infra-bot: pre-merge policy check failed: opa/gate (freeze-window). Rule: "no-capacity-increases-during-freeze" triggered. CI job: infra-ci-4521.
alex: minimal change is to bump gpu pool count from 6 -> 8. Snippet in PR:```
resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu-pool-a" {
  desired_capacity = 8
  min_size = 6
}
```
rachel: What's the business justification and the expected cost delta? Also who will own rollback if this impacts latency in prod?
devon: Quick thought — can we use burst capacity (short-lived spot/ephemeral) instead of a permanent pool increase? us-west-2 quotas are messy right now. Burst would add +2 GPUs for the job window.
luis: Burst is preferable if it meets SLA. If not, permanent increase requires 2 approvers + SRE signoff and a canary rollout. Add a label `canary=true` and limit rollout to one AZ at first.
sre-oncall: Current GPU cluster avg util ~78% on weekdays, spikes ~95% evenings. A permanent +2 might increase evictions. If you must, add autoscaler caps: max = current_max +2 and set eviction-safety hooks. Also monitor GPU reclaim metrics.
alex: Opening a JIRA for traceability: INF-7890. Justification: one-week model retrain required for regulated feature rollout; estimated cost ~ $1.2k/week. I'll add canary + autoscaler caps to PR.
opa-bot: To request an exception during freeze, please: 1) create ticket (JIRA) with TTL and justification, 2) add `gitops/opa-exception: <JIRA-ID>` to the PR description, 3) run `conftest test` locally and paste output. Exception TTL must be <= 72h. Example: `conftest test terraform/`
rachel: I can review the PR but need luis + sre-oncall approvals. Put the CI policy output in the PR and tag reviewers. Run `make ci-policy` locally and paste the log.
devon: Also if this touches helm charts for nodepool adoption, set `maxSurge: 1` and `maxUnavailable: 1` to avoid mass restarts.
alex: PR opened: https://git/redwood/infra/pulls/3221 — includes INF-7890 and `gitops/opa-exception: INF-7890` in the description. Ran `make ci-policy` and pasted the output.
infra-bot: CI: policy check still failing: freeze-window rule. Exception required via infra-exception form: https://go/rex/exception. Attach JIRA to request.
rachel: Reviewed the change set and the cost justification, :eyes: — LGTM pending luis + sre-oncall signoffs.
luis: Approved. Adding :thumbsup:. Setting exception TTL = 72h in the JIRA and noting canary first.
sre-oncall: Approved with conditions: limit autoscaler surge to +2 only, enable eviction-safety, and monitor for 24h after canary. If errors > 1% on p99 latency, rollback.
infra-bot: Exception recorded: INF-7890, TTL=72h. Merge permitted once PR has label `infra-exception-approved`.
alex: Thanks — will merge after canary completes. I'll post monitoring graphs in #incidents and revert if any regressions.
opa-bot: Reminder: freeze window ends at 1769510000. If the work can wait until then, prefer post-freeze merge.
rachel: :shipit: monitoring in place.
infra-bot: Merge blocked until `infra-exception-approved` label is added (automated gate).
